title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S1 E7 — Idaho Dirt Bike Tour, Oregon Overland Expo, Silver Kings Hard Enduro adventure
Our Ken Faught and crew head to Idaho to ride dirt bikes at the world-famous Gold Creek Lodge, then hit the Silver Kings Hard Enduro to see what this sport is all about. We top it off with a trip to the Oregon Overland Expo to check out new products.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S1 E8 — Kauai Overland, Costa Rica Dirt Bike & UTV Adventure, Yamaha Tenere Test
Our Ken Faught and Viola Bautista go overlanding on the Garden Island of Kauai. Our team also rides dirt bikes and drives UTVs in Costa Rica and tests Yamaha's impressive 700cc Tenere adventure bike.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S2 E8 — Moab Off-Road Adventure, Chase Gardender Solo Traveler, Beta X-Trainer Test
We head to Utah to go on an incredible off-road adventure in the world-famous Moab trail system. We also introduce you to solo traveler Chas Gardener and test Beta's impressive X-Trainer dirt bike.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S1 E11 — 1200-mile Dirt Bike Tour to the Arctice Ocean, Colorado UTV adventure, Bonnell bikes
Our Ken Faught makes a 1200-mile trek to the Arctic Circle on a motorcycle, then heads to Colorado for an unforgettable UTV adventure. We also test Bonnell electric bikes and KYB's all-new truck suspension.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S2 E10 — Hawaii UTV Tour, Montana dirt bike adventure, Nobo 10.7 Overland Trailer Test
Viola Bautista and Catherina Bertolino join Ken Faught at the famous Kipu Ranch in Hawaii.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S2 E11 — Utah 4x4 Adventure, Inside Far Out Camping Co., Honda Transalp Test
We head to Utah to go off-grid with an X-Games gold medalist who is also an amputee. We also test Far Out Camping Co.'s unique rig in Oregon and tell you all about Honda's Transalp adventure bike.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S2 E12 — Arizona Off-Road Adventure, Baja UTV test, Sun Lite 14 THX Trailer feature
We head to Baja to test a race UTV, then head to Arizona for another incredible off-road adventure. Our crew also tests Sun Lite's 14 THX toy hauler trailer. This is a cool concept that offers so much versatility.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S1 E12 — Jeep Project, Custom Van Build, Bali Off-Road Adventure
Our crew builds two project vehicles including a Jeep Wrangler and Mercedes Sprinter Vans. These are loaded with high-tech gadgets. We also head to Bali for unique off-road adventure and the sights will leave you breathless.
